findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_post_construction_estimate · Private data: get_time_slots · Public sink: get_post_construction_estimate, request_office_quote, send_message.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_post_construction_estimate · Private data: get_time_slots · Public sink: get_post_construction_estimate, request_office_quote, send_message

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
